newsitem.title: USA: Iwerks sees modest first quarter profit.
newsitem.headline: Iwerks sees modest first quarter profit.

text.p: Iwerks Entertainment Inc said Wednesday it expects a modest profit in the fiscal first quarter but may fall short of analysts' estimates for second quarter revenues and earnings.
Iwerks, which produces ride simulation, giant-screen theatres and 360-degree video dance clubs, said it still expects a profit for the full year fiscal 1997, which began on July 1.

"Shorter-term, we have recently experienced some customer-related delays with regard to recently signed simulation theatre contracts in Asia," said Roy Wright, Iwerks co-chairman. "These delays will result in a shortfall in revenues and earnings from analyst consensus estimates for the second quarter."
Iwerks said its balance sheet remains strong, with more than $22 million in cash and less than $3 million in long-term debt.
It also said it is still evaluating possible sponsors for its Reactor portable simulation theatres. It previously said an earlier sponsorship agreement had ended.
A new sponsorship agreement would not likely take effect until the third quarter, the company said.
